# Anthropic design skill attribution

The unchanged source skills and their licenses are included here for provenance.
Source: https://github.com/anthropics/skills
Pinned commit: ca45fc496a3436251f191354091d557da31c15b5 (retrieved 2026-11-03).
Upstream frontend-design and canvas-design are licensed under Apache License 2.0; each original LICENSE.txt is retained. The canvas license also includes upstream font notices. No upstream fonts, executable scripts or dependencies are distributed or used by this integration.

The EJ application uses the modified adaptation at ../../ej-social-design/SKILL.md, authored for this project on 2026-11-03. It adapts composition, hierarchy, negative space, restrained copy, coherent multi-page rhythm and review/refinement. It replaces upstream file-output and font-selection directions with the existing EJ brand, editable HTML/PNG runtime and structured model response. The unchanged upstream skills are archival source material, not dynamically loaded instructions. Models remain configured independently by the application.

The manifest records the exact source URLs, byte lengths and SHA-256 checksums.
